run_grid_search_explorer: run a DORA grid search explorer that launches experiments with varying hyperparameters using the launcher
create_custom_explorer_class: create a custom Explorer subclass that overrides get_grid_metrics to return loss as a grid metric
launch_experiment_grid: launch a grid of experiments by calling the launcher with different parameter values in a loop
bind_launcher_parameters: bind default parameters to the launcher so all subsequent calls inherit those parameter values
schedule_slurm_job_array: schedule a SLURM job array of experiments using launcher.job_array context manager with slurm config
